verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe confirmed this: an unauthenticated GET of /openapi/mesh-api.json returned a parseable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths (/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) only show the spec lives at a non-standard URL; they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: discoverability at a conventional or well-known path, and fuller first-party documentation of the spec's location and coverage beyond a brief mention.
